title: Customer spend ranking with electronics breakdown
prompt: For each customer, return their name (as customer_name), the total amount they have spent across all order items (as total_spent, computed as quantity multiplied by price, summed), the amount spent specifically on items in the 'Electronics' category (as electronics_spent, using conditional aggregation, 0 if none), and that customer's rank among all customers by total_spent descending (as spend_rank, using RANK so tied totals share a rank). Join the customers, orders, order items, products, and categories tables.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE cust19 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cust19 VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'); CREATE TABLE ord19 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO ord19 VALUES (1,1),(2,2),(3,1),(4,3); CREATE TABLE item19 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER, quantity INTEGER, price REAL); INSERT INTO item19 VALUES (1,1,1,1,1000.0),(2,1,3,2,150.0),(3,2,2,1,500.0),(4,3,4,1,80.0),(5,4,1,1,1200.0); CREATE TABLE prod19 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO prod19 VALUES (1,'Laptop',1),(2,'Phone',1),(3,'Desk',2),(4,'Chair',2); CREATE TABLE cat19 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cat19 VALUES (1,'Electronics'),(2,'Furniture');
reference_sql: SELECT cust19.name AS customer_name, SUM(item19.quantity * item19.price) AS total_spent, SUM(CASE WHEN cat19.name = 'Electronics' THEN item19.quantity * item19.price ELSE 0 END) AS electronics_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(item19.quantity * item19.price) DESC) AS spend_rank FROM cust19 JOIN ord19 ON cust19.id = ord19.customer_id JOIN item19 ON ord19.id = item19.order_id JOIN prod19 ON item19.product_id = prod19.id JOIN cat19 ON prod19.category_id = cat19.id GROUP BY cust19.id, cust19.name;
